# AI Engineering

**Build real products on top of LLMs: prompting, APIs, structured output, RAG, evals, and local models.**

Level: **Beginner** · 14 steps · 10h 07m of video · Prerequisites: Basic Python. No ML background needed.

## Build it

- Build "chat with my PDFs" over 20 of your own documents. Cite the source chunk in every answer.
- Write 30 test questions with known answers, then compare 3 chunk sizes and report retrieval hit rate.
- Ship a small LLM app (summarizer, tutor, or support bot) with an eval set that runs on every change.
